Actors Jr NTR and Janhvi Kapoor Condemn AI-Generated Deepfake Video

Actors Jr NTR and Janhvi Kapoor have condemned a vulgar artificial intelligence (AI) generated deepfake video featuring Janhvi Kapoor, reportedly set to the "Chuttamalle" song. Both actors have vowed to take legal action against the misuse of AI technology. Jr NTR specifically called for action against such misuse.
